title: Who Let the Goat Out?
story: Clementine the goat has never met a pie she didn't like, so when her pen came open at the county fair, she trotted straight into the pie tent. Nico swears she ate a dozen; the judges count two. Three people were leaning on the fence by her pen just before, and each says one thing. Can you work out who let her loose?
didnt: didn't leave the goat pen open
texts: Linus didn't leave the goat pen open.
Either Nico or I left the goat pen open.
Nico didn't leave the goat pen open.
rule_text: Exactly two of these statements are true.

question.text: Who left the goat pen open?
